messages:
Mira: Quick design sync — private setup wizard. Main ask: rethink network prereqs step. Current flow shows a large red X block for failures and pushes users to docs. Proposal: inline 're-run diagnostics' and an actionable 'copy command' that runs locally, plus a telemetry opt-in checkbox with concise copy. Thoughts?
Sam: Love inline re-run. Can we make the diagnostics incremental so they show progress per probe? e.g. 'DNS -> TCP -> Auth' with live dots. :eyes:
Jon: Agree. A11y note: status updates must use aria-live="polite" not assertive, and focus shouldn't jump unless there's an error modal. Also keyboard nav for collapsed panels.
Mira: Good call. For copy, I'm thinking: "Run a quick network check from your host — this won't send config to Redwood." Keep it short.
Tess: Wording tweak: "This check runs locally and does not transmit private IPs to Redwood." Might be clearer for customers.
Sam: UI layout question: stepper vs tabs. If we keep stepper, we should add a sticky summary on the right with 'Prereqs status' so users can see failing items at a glance.
Jon: Sticky summary + expand/collapse items is my vote. Also allow 'Copy CLI' next to each probe. Example command:
```
curl -fsS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4317/check \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"probe":"egress-ssh","port":22}'
```
Mira: Nice. Can we microcopy the clipboard action: 'Copy check command' instead of 'Copy'? Users mis-click otherwise.
Design-bot: Contrast check: failure pill (red #c23) on current mock is low contrast with white text — need WCAG AA.
Tess: Also add aria-labels for status pills: 'Prereq: Egress SSH — failed' so screenreaders read them in order.
Mira: Telemetry opt-in UI: Do we do inline text or a modal after success? I prefer inline unchecked checkbox with link to privacy doc.
Sam: Inline unchecked checkbox is best. Copy proposal: 'Help us improve setup diagnostics by sending non-sensitive telemetry (optional).' Link to 'what we collect'.
Jon: Ensure the telemetry toggle is role="switch" for screen readers and keyboard.
Mira: Ok action items: Jon to add a11y notes + aria props, Sam to update stepper with sticky summary prototype, Tess to update microcopy and telemetry copy, I'll update mock and upload new screens. I'll ping when done. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: mock uploaded — /img/wizard/1845000000-v2.png
Sam: cool, will review after lunch.
